senses.gloss:
I. 2 P. (यौति, युत; caus. यावयति; desid. यियविषति or युयूषति) 
__1 To join, unite. 
__2 To mix, combine. --II. 3 P. (युयोति) To detach, separate; as in युतसिद्ध. --III. 9 U. (युनाति, युनीते) 
__1 To bind, fasten. 
__2 To join, unite. 
__3 To mix, combine. 
__4 Ved. To give, grant. 
__5 To acquire. 
__6 To worship, respect. --IV. 10 Ā. (यावयते) To censure. -With व्यति to mix; अन्योन्यं स्म व्यतियुतः शब्दाञ् शब्दैस्तु भीषणान् [[Bk. 8. 6.]]
